name: Runtime undeclared item output rejection at output validation — Go/Java/C++ byte-exact
description: recall_static derives item field names from its `items` config param rather than from $metadata, so it is the production operator through which a write to an undeclared field is reachable from config alone (issue #205). The DAG's hazard inference is built only from the declared field lists, so an undeclared write carries no RAW/WAW/WAR edge; the engine therefore rejects it right after the operator-type method check and before apply_output. `rank` is written by the items payload but absent from item_output. Field names in the message are sorted bytewise so the list is byte-identical across runtimes regardless of map iteration order.

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: execution error in operator "seed_items": output contract violation: operator wrote undeclared item output field(s) [rank]
